messages:
Avery R.: Quick internal heads-up: we landed the sustained-inference benchmark optimizations on canary tonight for the small/medium family. Overall result: median down ~12ms, p95 down ~85ms, and estimated token-cost reduction ~9%. Felt like a solid cross-team win.

Kai M.: Nice! Summary of what changed?

Avery R.: Short version: two things shipped together: 1) adaptive kernel selector now prefers the new fused-attn path for short contexts, 2) a conservative per-model quant config that switches to int8 for matmuls under low-regret workloads. Both are runtime-only, no model weights modified.

Lena S.: Any customer-visible behavior change? We should coordinate a customer comms plan if regen quality is affected.

Kai M.: We ran the standard regression suite: 2M eval tokens + 2k fuzz prompts. No determinism flips on our CI anchors. Small increase in rounding differences for some soft-token probs but no downstream quality flags in our eval dashboards.

Avery R.: Bench command we used (perf harness):
```
$ ./perf_run --suite sustained-inference --models small,mid \
  --traffic-mix=prod-sim --duration=30m --collect=latency,cost,errors
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy 1/3 -> eu-west-1 cluster started at 22:11:07 by avery.r; image: runtime:v2026.4.02-kernel-int8

ops-watchdog-bot: Auto-monitoring policy applied: soak=48h, rollback_thresholds={p99: +15% over baseline, errors: +0.4% absolute} at 22:12:01

Lena S.: I added a short note to the product release notes draft. Also: let's be explicit about the rollout policy update. Ops, can you add a line in runbooks?

Avery R.: Yes. New internal rollout policy for runtime perf flags: any change expected to alter p95 or cost by >=5% requires: 
- 48h canary soak, 
- dedicated-pool 24h soak before Dedicated-wide rollout, 
- signoff from perf, infra, and product.

Kai M.: We'll add automated tracking for these changes so the alerts are easier to triage. I created a dashboard tile that shows p50/p95/p99 + cost_per_token delta for the specific model families so reviewers don't have to dig.

Lena S.: Heads-up to growth/solutions teams: if you see anything on customer pools that look off, ping #runtime-oncall and tag me.

Avery R.: Plan: continue canary -> 50% -> full in 36h if soak passes. I'll drop a short note in tomorrow's eng-synopsis with final numbers. Big thanks to Kai + infra for the late-night push.

Kai M.: Cheers 389

Lena S.: :sparkles: nice work everyone

Avery R.: I'll archive the perf artifacts and upload the bench CSVs to the shared drive after the soak completes.
